messages:
zoe: quick note from todays debug: encrypted safetensors bundle cold-starts vary a lot. payload decrypt + mmap of many small shards is the culprit. thinking we should make a small signed header envelope that we decrypt first and use for prioritized warmup

rahul: header envelope meaning manifest-only encrypted blob with per-shard roles/priority and checksum root?

zoe: exactly. fields: bundle_id, version, shards[id, role, range, enc_meta, hint], signer_kv, sig. tiny. cached locally keyed by bundle+keyv.

megan: ops constraints: KMS rate limits. header decrypt must be cheap and cached. payload decrypts gated by host semaphore and tenant token-bucket to avoid storms. Also need manifest TTL + invalidation webhook on key rotation

rahul: security: only trust priority hints from signed manifests (allowlist signers). unsigned manifests -> conservative schedule (base then kv). Also store signer_key_version in cache so rotations invalidate

zoe: fallback policy: if a prioritized shard fails checksum/404, try replica, then re-download full payload, else promote next shard set. We'll emit metrics and surface a "degraded" state to routing so requests can fallback to smaller model variant

megan: loader API: add options manifest_first:true, min_ready_roles:["kv","base"], and events on_manifest_ready, on_shard_ready(shard_id), on_degraded(bundle_id). Keep backward compatible if flag missing

rahul: telemetry: manifest_decrypt_ms, manifest_verify_ms, time_to_first_shard_ms, time_to_min_ready_ms, kms_calls_p50_p95. Also track concurrent_payload_decrypts and mem_reserved

zoe: placement: default per-host sidecar for latency. Private can centralize decryptor in VPC/HSM. doc should recommend header cache + local KMS proxy for high QPS

megan: timeline: quick RFC + spike next sprint to prototype sidecar RPC + loader hooks and a tiny simulator for bundle shapes. volunteers: rahul + megan for loader, zoe for RFC and security coordination

kms-bot: ticket INF-9001 created: "header-envelope staged hydration + fallback policy" (owner: zoe)

zoe: thanks all :thumbsup:
